title: mn7 must move AttemptSpec and friends out of epic-reconciler.ts before deleting it
body: cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts:63-69 imports type AttemptExecutor, AttemptHandle, AttemptReport, AttemptSpec and AttemptStatus from ./epic-reconciler, and sandbox-dispatch.ts:131 imports AttemptSpec. Deleting epic-reconciler.ts, as mn7 plans, breaks the build of the surviving door. Add this to mn7 (or a tick before it): relocate the types, then delete. mn7 also stays blocked until the xte gate run (W7) exists.
